sources_read: .qc-cache/hireops-lessons-2026-10-08-r5/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks row 37 (#36 grader_probes_are_not_pre_satisfied) and Internal Quality Checks row 37 (same check, column E blank; no comments/notes parts in the package), read via zipfile in memory
evidence: Manual application of the check-probe-not-in-seed procedure (quality-checks.md s.36 says that checker owns this row; the private checker was NOT executed, this is a hand grep, not a checker run). Collected every value the criteria tell the judge to create or type and searched for each in task/environment/assets/seed_data.json and the byte-identical task/solution/app/src/seed_data.json (both sha256 a1c65c80...7f3446f7e83740) and in the reference markup/JS (solution/app/public/index.html, js/app.js, js/board.js, js/threads.js, src/*, server.js). (1) Fixed literals: 'plain' (tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:158 hro_messaging) - 0 hits in seed or reference (also no '<b>'); the only 'plain' hits are 'text/plain' in board.js:242/303 drag code and the seed generated_note, neither is a message body. 'Call back on Fri' (polish/judge.toml:53, an example 'such as') - 0 hits. J1/J2/A2/single-letter card names - 0 hits as seed candidate/job names; seed names are full personal names (Noor Haddad, Ivo Marek, ... Mina Park) and job titles Platform Engineer/Data Analyst/Product Designer. (2) Created values are required to be unique: gate constraints judge.toml:115 and functional/polish/visual prompt gate text 'unique name, a unique email ... add a short suffix'; functional/prompt.md:21 'suffix every job title and candidate name for this session'; prompt.md:29 and polish/prompt.md:18 'Give every message, note or card created inside a timed action a unique suffix ... so the watched text cannot match anything older'; criteria require suffixed rejection reasons (hro_intake_restart, hro_activity, hro_candidate 'reason ending in a unique suffix (search every candidate response for it)'), suffixed messages (hro_intake_restart, hro_long_thread, hro_readonly_roles), 'note with new text' for replays (prompt.md:25), 'distinctive reply' (hro_pol_failed_send, hro_pol_session_resume). Board mutations run on new jobs the judge opens, so new cards/notes/orders cannot pre-exist in the seed. (3) Numeric probes: criteria use 2 interview places (hro_intake_restart, hro_moves, hro_reject_reopen, hro_interview_places, hro_bulk, hro_undo), which differs from the reference form default value '3' (board.js:65), so the 'places matches what was entered' leg is not satisfied by the default; invalid places 0, 51, 2.5 are refusals. (4) State probes vs seeded initial state: Rafael's read marker for APP-101 is 120 of 120 messages (seed reads[0]), so hro_long_thread's 'stays unread until he goes to the new message, then it is read' is not pre-satisfied by a seeded unread; new conversations created for Tomas start with no read markers; empty-box checks (hro_messaging after send, hro_drafts after send, hro_pol_session_resume Mei sees empty boxes) are not pre-satisfied by seeded drafts because the seed has no drafts and the reference textareas (board.js:89, threads.js:18) have no prefilled value. Seeded facts the criteria quote (Platform Engineer order, Noor's note 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.', Lena's unread 1, candidate wording) are reads of seeded state, not mutation probes, and are row 37's concern. Lessons file checked (handoffs/LESSONS_FROM_COLDERWATER_2026-10-08.md): lesson 7/14 unique-suffix timed markers present; lesson 15 restart check records several distinct suffixed items (jobs, card order, F's suffixed reason, note, suffixed message, Activity) and rereads all after restart_app - not satisfiable from seed; lesson 13 only localhost URLs used. Bounded observation (Note, P3, not a defect of this row as written): hro_intake_restart and the gate say 'any source' and grade only that a shown source 'matches what was entered'. The reference add-candidate form prefills Source 'Careers page' (board.js:43), which is also a common seed source value; a judge that keeps a prefilled default would not detect an app that ignores the typed source. Source is not a distinctive created probe in the criteria, so this does not make a probe pre-satisfied; asking for a suffixed source would harden it. Brief/rules check: instruction.md and hireops_rules.md contain no example value equal to any probe (hireops_rules.md:145 says messages are plain text, no 'plain' example). No runtime evidence needed for this static row; raw-evidence-index.json exists (input sha matches) but contains no configured judge run and was not used as evidence here.
